purpose: Check the certified finite formulas and compare their confidence reports with existing exact-binomial and Hoeffding reports under identical information. This does not replace the outstanding direct primary-proof comparison.
experiment: Original class K; fixed anchors (0,0),(1/2,1/2); retained n; full marked order; global unknown measurable detector in [1/R,1]. The evaluated upper methods use only the marked membership count.
crossover_ratios: For each q=sqrt(n), add R=(1+b)/(1-b) for b in {1/(2q),1/q,min(2/q,1/3)} that satisfy 0<=b<=1/3; deduplicate with the base ratios.
formula_checks: Build the two-variable polynomial 1+epsilon*(2u-1)*(2v-1); integrate its coefficients independently on the unit square and quarter square and convolve coefficients for its square. Check normalization, both marginal polynomials, target 1/4+epsilon/16 and second moment 1+epsilon^2/9 for fixed epsilons and epsilon=1/(2q).
At n=q^2, check exact product second moment, divergence<=1/35, finite Bernoulli power bound and n*(2/q)^2=4.

For all formula n/R pairs, check b=(R-1)/(R+1), the compensating detector ratio (1-b)/(1+b)=1/R, and strict target separation for the frozen joint radius min(1,1/q+b)/256 in the selected sampling/detector branch; include R=1 and exact crossover equality.

For each ratio and all Cartesian pairs in detector_coordinates, check global clamp bounds. On the unit square check rho*pi=1-b. This finite implementation check supplements the existing universal Lean proof.
For theta=j/16, j=0..16, check transformed lower/upper probabilities and their bias bounds at every ratio.
Check the separate n=0 deterministic error bound over the known physical range and the strict gap for the epsilon=1/2 lower pair.
reports: All methods intersect their report with the same known target range [1/8,3/8]; retain empty sets as empty with width zero and no coverage. Joint-rate report has center k/n and radius 2*min(1,1/q+b). At n=0 all methods return [1/8,3/8]. No-data known_range returns that range for every n.
count_grid: All k=0..n for n<=64, including n=0. For n=256,1024 use distinct k in {0,1,n/4,n/2,3n/4,n-1,n}. No full-law coverage or expected-width claim for those two larger sizes.
coverage_geometries: rho_epsilon with epsilon in fixed_epsilons, target v=1/4+epsilon/16; all are in original K by the accepted proof.
retention_pattern_definition: Global piecewise constant detector on the measurable marked interval and its complement: (pi_inside,pi_outside)=(1,1),(1/R,1),(1,1/R), respectively. Derive theta from v*pi_inside/(v*pi_inside+(1-v)*pi_outside) and compare the existing implementation.
coverage_computation: For every complete count grid and geometry/R/pattern, independently form exact rational binomial atom weights using math.comb, assert total mass one and sum covered atoms. Also compute exact expected width and empty-report probability. No Monte Carlo or numeric quadrature.
reported_precision: Coverage and empty-report probability are exact fractions. Expected widths are enclosed by outward rational rounding to denominator 10^12; this is display rounding only. Reportwise interval endpoints and widths are exact fractions.
negative_controls: Replace target epsilon/16 by epsilon/15 at epsilon=1/2; independent coefficient integration must reject it.
Replace the second-moment epsilon^2/9 by epsilon^2/8 at epsilon=1/2; coefficient convolution/integration must reject it.
Replace strict scalar separation 2*r<gap by its boundary r=gap/2; it must be rejected.
Remove the detector clamp at epsilon=1/2 and point (-1,2); the global detector bound must fail.
Shrink the n=16,k=4 binomial report to the point 1/4; its exact confidence-tail certificate must fail.
resource_interpretation: One complete run, including lazy SciPy import and serialization, with periodic deadline and traced-allocation checks. This memory metric excludes untraced native/process allocations; no comparative runtime speedup claim is made.

decision.validity_pass: Every formula equality/inequality, endpoint certificate, negative control and exact coverage>=19/20 check passes; no binomial fallback; source preservation and resource ceilings pass.
decision.report_preference: Only call joint_rate uniformly no wider on the tested report grid if its width<=transformed_exact_binomial at every paired count/R and it is strictly smaller at least once. Otherwise retain the exact-binomial report as the existing practical method and report any crossings without extrapolation.
decision.failure: Preserve all failed attempts; investigate defects. A scientific grid or threshold change requires a new version frozen before its execution. Implementation corrections require their own committed source and a fresh output directory under the same unchanged protocol.

source_and_artifact_control: Commit and push protocol plus runner before execution. Require a clean matching remote/local head and hash exact committed bytes of protocol, runner, reused estimator and relevant accepted Lean/proof files. Hash and preserve all pre-existing manuscript, pilot, acceptance and other tracked files. Create a new evidence directory; never overwrite the old pilot or a prior attempt.
remaining_comparison: After the Aronow-Lee full proof is available, determine whether an additional established comparator applies under identical observations and finite coverage requirements. Freeze any necessary amendment before evaluation; do not treat this provisional comparator set as an exhaustive prior-art comparison.
limits: Finite grid evidence verifies these executions, not universal mathematical statements or full Python semantics. Lean acceptance already supplies the universal theorem. No optimal constants, sharp identified set, physical detector, withheld application or operational advantage is established. S044 retains its own comparative protocol.
